name: I-29 Speedway Short Course
description: Short course of I-29 Speedway (formerly Raceway Park of the Midlands), Pacific Junction, Iowa. Uses the drag strip as the main straight, with T1/T5 transition bumps. 36 paddock pit boxes. Based on zwiss's v0.9 scratch build; open source (Apache-2.0).
author: Vybes Forge
